extracted.intended_audience: Researchers and grant applicants preparing NIH Biographical Sketch and Current & Pending (Other) Support forms (NIH applicants, research staff, UNC affiliates)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for preparing and submitting the NIH Common Forms for the Biographical Sketch and Current and Pending (Other) Support (including the biosketch supplement) for application due dates on or after January 25, 2026. Covers required tools, identifiers, product-list format, certification, and relevant effective dates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use SciENcv to complete Common Forms
rubrics_metrics.description: You will be required to use SciENcv to complete Common Forms (i.e., Biographical Sketch and CP(O) Support) and the NIH Biographical Sketch Supplement to produce digitally certified PDF(s) for use in application submission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: SciENcv (Science Experts Network Curriculum Vitae) is the researcher profile system for applicants/recipients of federal research funding. Use SciENcv to populate forms so that the system produces digitally certified PDFs suitable for submission. See SciENcv help and UNC guide links for step-by-step use.

rubrics_metrics.name: Have a My NCBI account and use one consistent login
rubrics_metrics.description: You will need a My NCBI account to create a biosketch in SciENcv. There are multiple ways to log into My NCBI (through eRA Commons, ORCID, UNC ONYEN, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose only one way to log in and use it consistently; if you log in multiple different ways, multiple accounts will be created. Set up My NCBI before starting SciENcv to avoid account duplication and data loss.

rubrics_metrics.name: ORCID iD is required and must be linked to eRA Commons
rubrics_metrics.description: You will be required to enter your ORCID iD in the Persistent Identifier (PI) section of the Common Forms. You will also need to link your ORCID iD with eRA Commons.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ORCID is a free, unique, persistent identifier for researchers. If you do not have an ORCID iD, create one and follow NIH/eRA guidance to link it to your eRA Commons account. UNC provides an ORCID guide and eRA has instructions for linking ORCID to eRA Commons.

rubrics_metrics.name: Products section format for Biosketch
rubrics_metrics.description: Rather than including citations within your personal statement and contributions to science, you must instead include a list of products that demonstrate your qualifications to carry out the project as proposed in the 'Products' section.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include: up to five products most closely related to the proposed project, and up to five other significant products (whether or not related to the proposed project) that demonstrate the senior/key person's qualifications. Do not embed citation lists in the personal statement or contributions sections; use the Products section per Common Forms instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Certification required to download forms
rubrics_metrics.description: Common Forms require certification: Forms cannot be downloaded until you agree to certain statements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When using SciENcv and generating the digitally certified PDFs, you must agree to and certify the required statements for the form to be downloadable and valid for NIH submission. Follow the prompts in SciENcv and the Common Forms interface to complete certification.

rubrics_metrics.name: New Common Forms effective dates and applicability
rubrics_metrics.description: Use of the new Common Forms for Biographical Sketch, Current and Pending (Other) Support, and NIH Biographical Sketch Supplement will be required for application due dates and all JIT, RPPR, and Prior Approval submissions on or after January 25, 2026.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult NOT-OD-26-018 for a table of effective dates relevant to different application, performance report, just-in-time and prior approval submission scenarios. To determine which Common Forms are required for a specific application, review the Notice of Funding Opportunity (NOFO).
